name: nova-kit

scripts.package: rm -rf dist-kit && mkdir -p dist-kit && rsync -a --exclude node_modules --exclude .next --exclude out --exclude .git --exclude .vercel --exclude .vercelignore --exclude dist-kit --exclude .wrangler --exclude qa --exclude HANDOFF.md --exclude figma-OBSOLETE-working-copy --exclude .claude/launch.json --exclude .claude/settings.local.json --exclude tsconfig.tsbuildinfo --exclude next-env.d.ts . dist-kit/nova-kit/ && cd dist-kit && zip -qr nova-kit.zip nova-kit && rm -rf nova-kit && echo 'dist-kit/nova-kit.zip'

description: NOVA, an AI-ready SaaS website kit: 15 pages in Next.js + Tailwind, built 1:1 from Figma, with a design system, component catalog and playbooks for AI coding agents.
